story: Mother goes to the municipality for English birth certificates. Told 'not possible now'. A clerk asks ৳2,000 and says collect tomorrow. She bargains and pays ৳1,000 to the clerk.
Maria asks for her SSC testimonial at the school office. The officer asks ৳4,000. She objects. The head says the school runs on this money. She pays ৳725 to the officer and waits through lunch.

Maria applies for her national ID. First 'it won't happen', then 'talk to sir'. Sir never says a number but she understands he means ৳11,500. She pays ৳2,750 to be first in the serial. Card in 72 hours.
Passport refused three times over small faults. A broker outside quotes ৳2,011. She pays ৳2,500 in total. After that the same application has no faults.
She passes every test but the result says fail. A broker asks ৳4,750. She bargains and pays ৳3,500. On the next date she gets 'pass' without sitting the test.
After a normal delivery in a government hospital, a nurse demands ৳1,000. 'No payment, no help.' The family bargains and pays ৳500 to the nurse.
Maria, now a teacher, claims her increment arrears at the accounts office. Staff ask ৳5,000 and send her back day after day. She pays ৳4,500 and the bill moves.
New paper required on every visit to the city corporation. Then a peon says ৳12,000 and nothing else is needed. She pays ৳3,000 to the peon, then the official fee. Licence next day.
Her meter application is cancelled for 'distance'. The investigator sends her to an electrician who asks ৳4,250. She pays ৳5,500 in total. The meter is installed at the original spot.
The mutation file sits six months. They ask ৳12,000. She pays ৳10,000 in steps: office assistant, tehsildar, kanungo, surveyor, and again at the hearing.
At the fingerprint step of the mortgage registration, ৳12,000 is asked or the registration is cancelled. She bargains and pays ৳2,000. She never learns what it was for.
Police do not take her land-grab case. They ask ৳20,000 across the visits. She pays ৳3,000 and stops pursuing it.
Husband's family pension at the education office accounts. They ask ৳62,500 in two asks. She pays ৳20,000 and the work is still not done.
Maria dies in the ICU. Ward boys will not hand over the body without payment. The family pays ৳700 (one report). No median for this scene.
At the councillor's office the family is asked ৳2,000 for the death certificate, 'no other way'. They pay ৳3,000 in cash.
Her children apply for the heirs' certificate. A man visits the house to verify, then the administrative officer. They are asked ৳2,000 in total and pay ৳3,000: ৳2,000 at home, ৳1,000 at the office.
